sources.entry: MacSystemColors - Mac app that shows all system colors in light and dark mode for Cocoa developers. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/kaunteya/MacSystemColors)

summary.one_liner: MacSystemColors is a Mac app that catalogues every Cocoa system color provided by NSColor, shown in light and dark mode.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only states that the project is a catalogue of all Cocoa colors provided by NSColor. The awesome-mac listing describes it as a Mac app that shows the system colors in light and dark mode for Cocoa developers. The README gives no details on the interface, install steps, or how colors are displayed or copied. Treat the feature list as limited to what the one-line description and listing state.
use_cases: look up NSColor system color values
compare system colors in light and dark mode
reference Cocoa colors while building macOS apps
notable: Catalogues the Cocoa colors provided by NSColor
Shows each system color in both light and dark mode
Listed in awesome-mac under Developer Utilities
caveats: README is minimal, with no install, usage, or build instructions
License is not stated in the README or metadata provided
